integrity: The infinite tail is proved by exact algebraic elimination and Sturm root counts; finite interval checks are used only for denominator degrees 5 through 26. No floating-point experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats numerator degree 5 only; no claim is made for numerator degree 6 or larger. The proof uses exact symbolic/resultant and interval certificates for two auxiliary inequalities.
title: One-sigma variation comparison for \(F(5,d)\)
